accessNotes: RECAPTURE 2026-10-14: re-fetched https://ofpfunding.com/ (curl with desktop UA; 200) and parsed the embedded __NUXT_DATA__ plan payload (80 plan objects). The live lineup is ONLY Instant Lite, Instant Classic and Instant Plus, each in 3/5-or-6 and 5/10 drawdown variants and 80%/100% split. /trading-rules tabs also list only 'Instant Lite Instant Classic Instant Plus'. Products REMOVED because they no longer appear anywhere in the official payload or pages: instant-prime, instant-pro, one-phase-challenge, two-phase-challenge. Instant Lite 5%/10% variant added as a new row. Help-centre rule text carried forward. | Prior notes: ACCESS: ofpfunding.com returns HTTP 403 to the WebFetch tool (bot protection). Pages were retrieved over plain HTTPS with a standard desktop browser User-Agent, which returns HTTP 200. No geo-block encountered. ofpfunding.com/pricing-plans/ 301-redirects to the homepage anchor https://ofpfunding.com/#pricing. JS-GATING: the pricing widget and the per-product tabs on /trading-rules are client-side rendered; only ONE pricing column (Instant Lite / $50,000 / 80% split) and rules section 1 are present in the server HTML. METHOD + VALIDATION: all per-product numbers below come from the Nuxt __NUXT_DATA__ JSON payload embedded in the server HTML of ofpfunding.com itself - i.e. the firm's own published data that renders the visible widget, not a third party. It was validated against the one server-rendered column: the payload record for Instant Lite / $50,000 / 80% split gives price 150, dailyDrawdown 3, maxDrawdown 5, profitTarget 5, minTradingDays 5, maxTradingDays 30, payoutDays 30 - and the visible HTML independently renders '$150', 'Account Price', '$50,000 - Lite Account', '5% Overall Drawdown', '3% Daily Drawdown', 'Profit Target 5%', 'Minimum Trading Days 5', 'Account Duration 30 Days', 'Payout Day Monthly'. Exact match on every field. The other product columns could NOT be visually confirmed in a browser; treat them as firm-published data rather than firm-rendered data. CONSISTENCY RULE - UNRESOLVED, LEFT NULL: the pricing payload carries a 'maxScore' field (One Phase / Two Phase = 15, Instant Classic = 20, Instant Lite / Plus / Pro / Prime = null) which appears to feed the pricing table's 'Consistency Ratio' row. Only the null case was visually confirmed (Instant Lite renders 'No' / 'No Consistency'). The help centre instead ties the threshold to the payout cycle, not the product: 'On-Demand Accounts: Your score must be under 10%. Bi-Weekly Accounts: Your score must be under 15%. Monthly Accounts: Your score must be under 20%.' That directly contradicts the payload for Instant Classic (payoutDays=14 i.e. bi-weekly, but maxScore=20) and for Instant Lite (monthly, but no consistency rule shown). Because the firm's own two sources disagree and the rendered number was never observed, consistencyRulePct is null for every product. Formula published by the firm: 'Inconsistency Score = Best Day Closed PnL / Total Closed PnL x 100' (ofpfunding.com/trading-rules); it is a soft rule - 'you won't lose the account if the score exceeds the recommended' - but 'you are not entitled to request a payout'. INSTANT PLUS: sold on the pricing widget but has NO rules section on ofpfunding.com/trading-rules (only instant-lite, instant-classic, instant-pro, instant-prime, one-phase, two-phase categories exist there). Its product-specific rules are unverified. NOT PUBLISHED ANYWHERE ON THE FIRM'S DOMAIN (left null): weekend-holding rules, overnight/swap-holding rules, the per-phase profit-target split for the Two Phase product, and max trading days for every product except Instant Lite. PRICING STRUCTURE: every account is sold at two profit-split tiers, 80% (base price, recorded in priceUsd) and 100% (~20% more, recorded inside each accountSizes evidence string). Instant Classic and Instant Plus are additionally sold in two drawdown variants, which are emitted here as separate product objects. REFUNDABLE: 'traders are entitled to request a refund within 14 calendar days from the date of purchase, provided that the account has not been used and no trading activity has occurred' - so refundable=true only for an untouched account; 'Refunds are not available after the 14-day period has elapsed or once any trade has been placed.' OTHER VERIFIED FIRM-WIDE TERMS: leverage 'may range from a minimum of 1:1 to a maximum of 1:100' (dynamic); instruments 'Forex, Crypto, Indices, Metals & Energies'; platform MetaTrader 5 / OFP Platform; 'The total manageable accounts are capped at $300,000. Account merging is not supported at OFP Funding.'; inactivity 28 consecutive days -> suspension; withdrawals 'typically processed within an average timeframe of 48 hours', crypto/bank free below $500, above $500 via Rise with a fixed $50 fee; scaling plan '20% total profit over three months -> 25% return on your initial deposit'. Entity: OFP Funding Ltd (St. Lucia, company 2024-00577); payment agent FINTEKNOLOGY LTD, UK (15131112). Simulated/demo trading only; MT5 services 'not intended for U.S. citizens/residents'.
